Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Sun, Oct 25 7:16am to 6:36pm; Mon, Oct 26 7:17am to 6:34pm; Tue, Oct 27 7:19am to 6:33pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Sun, Oct 25 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Proper outflow Sunday. Pam Rocks reads NNE 21 at 5am, still a touch behind the page’s 27 to 28, and Environment Canada calls it stronger again.

My pick is Porteau from first light around 7:20 until about noon, NNE 22 to 28 with good swell. The tide drops from 14.2ft at 6am to 9.2ft at 11:30, then the flood starts, so go early. If Pam Rocks reads 22+ from the north at 8am, go.

Backup is Boundary Bay, E 14 to 18 until about 9:30am, then about 13 from 1:30pm to last light, once the tide is back over 10ft.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:23 PM PDT 25 October 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Monday. Gale warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 20 to 25 knots increasing to northerly outflow 25 to 35 this evening then diminishing to northerly outflow 10 to 20 Monday morning. EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PDT 25 October 2026): Tonight and Monday. Wind easterly 10 to 20 knots becoming northwest 10 to 20 late this evening then becoming southeast 5 to 15 Monday evening.
